item.title: Float Switch vs Optical Sensor ATOs for Nano Tanks
item.description: The real question The useful question is not which sensor sounds more advanced on a product page. The useful question is how each sensing approach behaves when the tank gets dirty, the mount shifts slightly, or maintenance gets delayed because life is annoying. In nano tanks, tiny errors matter faster. That makes graceful failure more important than gadget marketing. Short answer Float switches are mechanically simple and easy to understand, but they can stick, drag, or get obstructed.
